overview: The Liquor License Commission approved several one-day licenses and a manager change for Associazione Amici. They tabled a manager change for the Riverside Yacht Club due to application defects and postponed adopting state rules on early Sunday alcohol sales.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved meeting minutes for July 19, August 9, September 20, and October 18, 2023.

items.title: One-Day Licenses: Medford Brewing Company
items.summary: Approved two one-day licenses for the Winter Extravaganza on November 29 and the Rotary 100th anniversary on December 14, conditioned on submitting a site diagram.

items.title: One-Day License: Medford Historical Society
items.summary: Approved a one-day license for a December 6 fundraiser and toy collection at 10 Governors Avenue.

items.title: Change of Manager: Associazione Amici, Inc.
items.summary: Approved Fabio Riparo as the new manager for Associazione Amici at 21 Reardon Road.

items.title: One-Day License: Tufts University Catering
items.summary: Approved a one-day license for a senior class bingo event at the Joyce Cummings Center on December 1, pending an updated floor plan marking the bar location.

items.title: One-Day Licenses: Event Horizon / Event Them Studios
items.summary: Approved three one-day licenses for events on November 19, December 1, and December 8 at 344 Salem Street.

items.title: Change of Manager: Riverside Yacht Club
items.summary: Tabled an application for a manager change to Michael Gargano due to illegibility, incomplete fields, and lack of TIP certification.

items.title: Discussion of M.G.L. Chapter 138, Section 33B (Sunday Alcohol Sales)
items.summary: Tabled adoption of Chapter 138, Section 33B, which permits Sunday alcohol sales starting at 10 a.m., until the full commission is present.
